--* generate voucher * DECLARE @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000), @Src VARCHAR(3), @Des VARCHAR(3), @AppDB VARCHAR(64), @SysDB VARCHAR(64), @iObject VARCHAR(128), @iTbl VARCHAR(128), @iKey VARCHAR(128), @AppType0 VARCHAR(4000), @AppType1 VARCHAR(4000), @AppType2 VARCHAR(4000), @SysType0 VARCHAR(4000), @SysType1 VARCHAR(4000), @SysType2 VARCHAR(4000), @SysType3 VARCHAR(4000), @i INT
SET @Src = 'TS1'; SET @Des = 'ZHD'; SET @AppType0 = 'dmct#ma_ct, sysspmasterinfo#xid, dmloaict#ma_ct, dmmagd#ma_ct, dmttct#ma_ct, dmxlct#ma_ct, sysflowinfo#ma_ct, sysspdetailinfo#xid' SET @AppType1 = ''; SET @AppType2 = 'sysinventory#xvoucher' SET @SysType0 = 'voucherinfo#ma_ct, sysuserdef#ma_ct, sysgridinfo#ma_ct, message#form, reports#form, repinfo#form, sysstatusinfo#ma_ct'; SET @SysType1 = ''; SET @SysType2 = 'freecodeinfo#vouchers, freefieldsinfo#vouchers, popup#vouchers'; SET @SysType3 = 'grid#code'
PRINT '-- App' SET @i = 1 WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @AppType0 + ',', @i) > 0 BEGIN SET @iObject = LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@AppType0 + ',', @i, CHARINDEX(',', @AppType0 + ',', @i) - @i)) SET @iTbl = LEFT(@iObject, CHARINDEX('#', @iObject, 1) - 1) SET @iKey = SUBSTRING(@iObject, CHARINDEX('#', @iObject, 1) + 1, 128)
SET @strSQL = 'SELECT * INTO #' + @iTbl + ' FROM ' + @iTbl + ' WHERE ' + @iKey + ' = ''' + @Src + '''; UPDATE #' + @iTbl + ' SET ' + @iKey + ' = ''' + @Des + '''; INSERT INTO ' + @iTbl + ' SELECT * FROM #' + @iTbl PRINT @strSQL
SET @i = CHARINDEX(',', @AppType0 + ',', @i) + 1 END
SET @i = 1 WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @AppType2 + ',', @i) > 0 BEGIN SET @iObject = LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@AppType2 + ',', @i, CHARINDEX(',', @AppType2 + ',', @i) - @i)) SET @iTbl = LEFT(@iObject, CHARINDEX('#', @iObject, 1) - 1) SET @iKey = SUBSTRING(@iObject, CHARINDEX('#', @iObject, 1) + 1, 128)
SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE ' + @iTbl + ' SET ' + @iKey + ' = RTRIM(' + @iKey + ') + '', '' + ''' + @Des + ''' WHERE ' + @iKey + ' LIKE ''%' + @Src + '%''' PRINT @strSQL
SET @i = CHARINDEX(',', @AppType2 + ',', @i) + 1 END
PRINT '-- Sys' SET @i = 1 WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @SysType0 + ',', @i) > 0 BEGIN SET @iObject = LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@SysType0 + ',', @i, CHARINDEX(',', @SysType0 + ',', @i) - @i)) SET @iTbl = LEFT(@iObject, CHARINDEX('#', @iObject, 1) - 1) SET @iKey = SUBSTRING(@iObject, CHARINDEX('#', @iObject, 1) + 1, 128)
SET @strSQL = 'SELECT * INTO #' + @iTbl + ' FROM ' + @iTbl + ' WHERE ' + @iKey + ' = ''' + @Src + '''; UPDATE #' + @iTbl + ' SET ' + @iKey + ' = ''' + @Des + '''; INSERT INTO ' + @iTbl + ' SELECT * FROM #' + @iTbl PRINT @strSQL
SET @i = CHARINDEX(',', @SysType0 + ',', @i) + 1 END
SET @i = 1 WHILE CHARINDEX(',', @SysType2 + ',', @i) > 0 BEGIN SET @iObject = LTRIM(SUBSTRING(@SysType2 + ',', @i, CHARINDEX(',', @SysType2 + ',', @i) - @i)) SET @iTbl = LEFT(@iObject, CHARINDEX('#', @iObject, 1) - 1) SET @iKey = SUBSTRING(@iObject, CHARINDEX('#', @iObject, 1) + 1, 128)
SET @strSQL = 'UPDATE ' + @iTbl + ' SET ' + @iKey + ' = RTRIM(' + @iKey + ') + '', '' + ''' + @Des + ''' WHERE ' + @iKey + ' LIKE ''%' + @Src + '%''' PRINT @strSQL
SET @i = CHARINDEX(',', @SysType2 + ',', @i) + 1 END
SET @strSQL = 'SELECT * INTO #grid FROM grid WHERE code IN (SELECT sysid FROM sysgridinfo WHERE ma_ct = ''' + @Src + '''); UPDATE #grid SET code = ''' + @Des + ''' + SUBSTRING(code, 3, 128); INSERT INTO grid SELECT * FROM #grid' PRINT @strSQL --* End - generate voucher *

--* alter view * DECLARE @ViewName NVARCHAR(4000), @strSQL NVARCHAR(4000) DECLARE extensionViews CURSOR FOR SELECT name FROM sysobjects WHERE xtype IN ('V') AND id IN (SELECT id FROM syscomments WHERE (TEXT LIKE '%KeySearch%')) OPEN extensionViews FETCH NEXT FROM extensionViews INTO @ViewName WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN SET @strSQL = 'exec sp_refreshview N''dbo.' + @ViewName + '''' PRINT @strSQL -- EXEC sp_executesql @strSQL FETCH NEXT FROM extensionViews INTO @ViewName END CLOSE extensionViews DEALLOCATE extensionViews --* End - alter view *

--* reset identiy * SELECT 'DECLARE @MaxId INT' UNION ALL SELECT 'set @MaxId = null' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'select @MaxId = max(' + COLUMN_NAME + ') from ' + TABLE_NAME + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'if @MaxId is null set @MaxId = 0' + CHAR(13) + CHAR(10) + 'DBCC CHECKIDENT (' + CHAR(39) + TABLE_NAME + CHAR(39) + ', RESEED, @MaxId)' FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND COLUMNPROPERTY(OBJECT_ID(TABLE_NAME), COLUMN_NAME, 'IsIdentity') = 1 AND TABLE_NAME IN (SELECT name FROM sysobjects WHERE xtype = 'u') --* End - reset identiy *

--* delete data * SET NOCOUNT ON SELECT IDENTITY(INT, 1, 1) AS _id, CAST('' AS NVARCHAR(4000)) AS script INTO #tScript WHERE 1 = 0 DECLARE @strsql NVARCHAR(4000), @tbl VARCHAR(64), @lst_f NVARCHAR(4000) DECLARE xcur CURSOR FOR SELECT name FROM sysobjects WHERE xtype = 'u' ORDER BY name OPEN xcur FETCH NEXT FROM xcur INTO @tbl WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN SET @strsql = 'if exists(select 1 from ' + @tbl + ') insert into #tScript(script) select ''delete ' + @tbl + ' -- select * from ' + @tbl + '''' EXEC sp_executesql @strsql FETCH NEXT FROM xcur INTO @tbl END CLOSE xcur DEALLOCATE xcur SELECT script FROM #tScript ORDER BY _id DROP TABLE #tScript --* End - delete data *

SET NOCOUNT ON GO DECLARE @ma_ct CHAR(3), @stt_rec CHAR(13) , @cMasterTable VARCHAR(16), @cDetailTable VARCHAR(16) , @cGLMasterTable VARCHAR(16), @cGLDetailTable VARCHAR(16) , @cGroups VARCHAR(128), @sp_post VARCHAR(64) , @strsql NVARCHAR(4000), @i INT
